jsdoc.summary:
Represents the parser and data model used to process JSDoc annotations.
The class parses JSDoc comment content, converts tags into structured data,
resolves referenced types, and creates internal representations for
functions, variables, properties, classes, and type definitions.

properties.name: arrayTags
properties.description: Tags whose values are stored as arrays, such as parameters and properties.

properties.name: typeTags
properties.description: JSDoc tags that represent or reference a type.

properties.name: definitionTags
properties.description: JSDoc tags that define a code element.

properties.name: referenceTags
properties.description: JSDoc tags that reference another code element or definition.

params.name: key
params.description: the key to be used in the handler, ex: the key of "+" is "sum"

params.name: tag
params.description: (optional) The tag name of the element, defaults to "div"

params.name: classList
params.description: (optional) The class list of the element

params.name: callback
params.description: (optional) Executed when the element is created, ex: (element) => element.innerHTML = "Hello world"; or function() { this.innerHTML = "Hello world"; }
